title: JSON, CSV and file boundaries
summary: Treat serialization as an I/O boundary: decode, validate, transform, then encode.

blocks.text: Treat serialization as an I/O boundary: decode, validate, transform, then encode.

items: JSON preserves nested objects and arrays but has a small type system.
CSV is tabular text; quoting, delimiter, encoding and newline handling matter.
Open text files with an explicit encoding such as UTF-8.
Separate file transport from business transformations for easier tests.

blocks.code:
import json
from pathlib import Path

data = json.loads(Path("input.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if not isinstance(data, list):  # assert is skipped under python -O
    raise ValueError("expected a JSON array at the top level")
